model.scope: native service burst lease before RTL; no physical/token claim
model.mux_demux: existing one-active-PC stack response mux; one local length check per PC

latency.system_composition: 256 sectors at length8: 32 command admissions plus same 256 data cycles; downstream wait and dispatcher must be composed

model.backpressure: PHY advances only when register empty or consumer accepts current beat
model.identity: native tag and sequential beat 0..length-1 checked before PHY acceptance
model.caller_address_contract: All requested K sectors belong to selected PC; global address translator splits bursts at every PC boundary (mapped consecutive groups may limit length to4).
